verdicts.reason: A: the attribution floats about 60px below the quote, so it no longer reads as part of it. It is also indented to x≈18 while the quote starts at x≈10, and the logo row sits on the purple circle and is jammed against the bottom edge. B keeps the attribution with the quote, but the gap is too tight and the same left-edge misalignment remains. The quote mark is offset further right than the text, there is a dead band above the quote, and the logo is still cramped onto the circle near the bottom.
